sailors.biography:
A veteran by the standards of many, John Gimson has forged a career in various formats of sailing and followed up success in the lead-up to Tokyo alongside Anna Burnet with silver in the Nacra 17 class at the 2020 Games.
The duo won the 2020 Nacra 17 World Championships plus silver medals at the 2019 European Championships, World Cup Final and the Olympic test event.

Gimson's youth career yielded silver medals at the World and European Championships and his CV also features a 2013 Americas Cup appearance, as well eight years racing keelboats.

Gimson joined Iain Percy and Andrew Simpson in 2012 as their tuning partner for the Star class for the Olympic cycle ahead of the London Games but the Star class was dropped as an Olympic event following 2012, leading to his eventual switch to Nacra 17.

And he and Burnet would cap off a remarkable day for British sailing on the Olympic stage in Japan, earning silver after Stuart Bithell and Dylan Fletcher, and Giles Scott, had earlier scooped gold.

That Tokyo silver was far from the final curtain call for the duo, who added a second world title to their collection later in the year.
sailors.name: John Gimson
